content: Thiazole installed and SA is good at 1.71, but LogP is 4.14 and QED 0.760 - again the benzoyl, which at three aromatic rings and 295 Da is simply the wrong cap for this series. Atom 1 is the amide carbonyl and atom 15 is the ipso carbon of the phenyl, a non-ring bond, so I swap the ring for a methyl. That gives N-[4-(1,3-thiazol-2-ylamino)phenyl]acetamide at ~233 Da: LogP back near 2.6, two aromatic rings, SA about 1.6, matched in every other respect to the acetanilide pyridine and pyrimidine links so the thiazole comparison is clean.
